title: just a good modpack
description: just a better minecraft for those who are bored with the original version
body: this is a modpack filled with mods for a better Minecraft experience such as mods that improve game performance, resource packs that make it look better, and shaders that make the game more immersive.The mod pack adds many features that make the game more enjoyable and challenging. It also adds biomes with the original blocks, improves terrain formation, adds really beautiful structures, and the End also gets new biomes thanks to Better End. For the Nether, the biomes remain the same; all the game's structures are improved for a greater challenge. The resource pack makes the game look prettier.(I recommend you install the "Stay True" texture pack on your end.)
